dataset.membership_source: Split folder of each image in the HF dataset dronefreak/RDD2022 @ 72b01f94c2e5bfe430861afd73995f2d412b8855 (DetectionBench RDD2022 export; data/images/{train,valid,test}). Split sizes 26,869/5,758/5,758 equal DetectionBench docs/datasets/rdd2022/README.md @ 5efbe794. The 27 test-split images of our subset were checked byte-identical (sha256) to the mirror copies on 2026-10-03.

how: COCO AP (pycocotools, maxDets 100) of run_registered_model predictions down to score 0.001 against the subset's own Pascal-VOC boxes, D00/D10/D20/D40 -> longitudinal/transverse/alligator/pothole; other RDD labels dropped as DetectionBench drops them.
caveats: Small N: one image moves per-class AP by several points.
Our boxes are the original RDD2022 VOC annotations; DetectionBench used the RDD_SPLIT YOLO export of the same images.
Not comparable to the CRDDC2022 leaderboard, as the publisher also says.
